page_title: HAV 0-0 PAR | Le Havre v Paris FC 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' A neat pass is well received by Nouha Dicko (Paris FC), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' It is time for a substitution. Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) is on for Ilan Kebbal.
88' Adama Camara (Paris FC) sees a yellow card from Ruddy Buquet after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
88' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
85' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Younes Namli (Le Havre).
85' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arouna Sangante.
79' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the right post.
79' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
78' The main referee, Ruddy Buquet, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is given a yellow card for dissent.
77' Referee Ruddy Buquet awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
76' Referee Ruddy Buquet makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
76' PENALTY APPEAL by Le Havre, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

76' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) finds his teammate, who is lurking close to the offside line, with a nice through pass. The opponent's defence is having a really hard time dealing with these kind of situations.
74' It will be a corner kick for Paris FC.
73' Here is a change. Ally Samatta is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Fode Doucoure (Le Havre).
73' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noam Obougou (Le Havre) replacing Godson Kyeremeh.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Philippe Krasso trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nouha Dicko (Paris FC).
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tuomas Ollila will be replaced by Thibault De Smet (Paris FC).

71' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Paris FC force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Moses Simon will be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
66' Substitution. Alimani Gory (Paris FC) replaces Vincent Marchetti.
64' Le Havre fail to score from a corner as Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) leaps to collect the ball.
62' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
62' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
60' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) has again attempted to split the defence with a through ball.
58' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Kevin Trapp easily deals with the threat.
56' Great touch by Adama Camara (Paris FC) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
55' CHANCE! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
52' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ruddy Buquet stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
50' The corner by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
47' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
45+1' Didier Digard is forced to make a change. Simon Ebonog is unable to continue due to injury, Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) comes on.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Looks like Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

39' OFF THE POST! Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
36' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
35' Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
34' It will be a free kick from the middle of the park. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is looking around and deciding who will be the best choice to start a new attack with.
32' A long pass finds Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
29' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
28' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

24' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
23' The ball is out of play. Le Havre will have a throw-in.
17' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Kevin Trapp has no trouble gathering it.
16' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

11' What a great effort! Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
9' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just over the bar.
6' None of the Le Havre players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
5' A corner kick by Le Havre is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Trapp (Paris FC).
2' Le Havre keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Le Havre will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ruddy Buquet.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
